A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same ScaPre research work. All 24 pages, including figures, tables, equations and Appendices A-D, are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix C report original concept-unlearning experiments, including benchmark comparisons, efficiency measurements, adversarial tests and ablations.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix C retain the original empirical results on unlearning effectiveness, generation quality, efficiency, robustness and component ablations.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain identical spectral trace regularization, Informax decoupling, geometry alignment, Sylvester solution and proximal refinement procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Imagenette, ImageNet-Diversi50, ImageNet-Confuse5, 50 artistic styles, I2P and MS COCO-30K, with the same adversarial scenarios. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within every experiment. Main comparisons retain FMN, SPM, ESD, MACE, UCE, RECE and SP; I2P Tables 8-9 retain their distinct comparator set, including AC and excluding RECE.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix C retain the same Stable Diffusion versions, concept counts, target/preservation designs and evaluation metrics. The I2P evaluation still uses 4,703 prompts and a NudeNet confidence threshold of 0.6.

E4.justification: The adversarial tests, component ablations, generative-quality analyses and alternative UQ-normalization checks are identical in Appendix C.3-C.7, including Figure 11 and Tables 10 and 13-16.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version supplies repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests; the across-method statistics used for UQ normalization also remain identical.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match across Tables 1-16 and the figures. For example, ScaPre retains Imagenette accuracy/UQ of 0.8/64.09 in Table 1 and ImageNet-Diversi50 accuracy/UQ of 3.9/65.30 in Table 3.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, Sylvester uniqueness argument and Bures/Procrustes derivations are unchanged in Sections 3-5 and Appendix B. Appendix C's alternative UQ definitions also match.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same scalability, precision and efficiency claims, including up to fivefold greater concept capacity and unlearning 50 concepts in 120 seconds.

C2.justification: Explanations of conflict suppression and selective updating, and interpretations of quality preservation, baseline collapse and adversarial resilience, are unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: v2 adds a ScaPre GitHub repository link and states that code is available in the abstract; v1 only promises future release in Section 8. Implementation disclosures and Appendix D's baseline links are unchanged. Section 8 retains the future-release wording in v2.

R1.justification: Section 2, the bibliography and the paper's novelty positioning are unchanged. No cited prior work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 adds the ICLR 2026 publication header and one code-availability sentence, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Remaining prose and section/appendix organization are identical.

P2.justification: Publication headers are added throughout, and Figure 1 and abstract spacing shift slightly on the first page. Figure/table contents and captions are unchanged; rendered page bodies on pages 2-24 are identical.

improvement.justification: The new repository pointer modestly improves reproducibility documentation over v1's future-release promise. Scientific evidence is unchanged. The benefit is limited by Section 8's retained future-release wording, and the PDFs do not establish the repository's contents or usability.
